CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_get_staff(p_staff_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  bid uuid := public.admin_require_caller_business_id();
  result jsonb;
begin
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'staff_id', s.id,
    'username', s.username,
    'display_name', s.display_name,
    'role', s.role,
    'active', s.active,
    'terminated_at', s.terminated_at,
    'created_at', s.created_at,
    'updated_at', s.updated_at,
    'business_id', s.business_id,
    'shops', public.admin_staff_shops_json(s.id)
  )
  into result
  from public.staff s
  where s.id = p_staff_id
    and s.business_id = bid;

  if result is null then
    raise exception 'not found' using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  return result;
end;
$function$

functions.name: admin_staff_shops_json
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_staff_shops_json(p_staff_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce((
    select jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object('id', sh.id, 'name', sh.name)
      order by sh.name
    )
    from public.staff s
    join public.shops sh on sh.business_id = s.business_id and sh.active
    where s.id = p_staff_id
      and (
        s.role = 'owner'
        or exists (
          select 1
          from public.staff_shops ss
          where ss.staff_id = s.id
            and ss.shop_id = sh.id
        )
      )
  ), '[]'::jsonb);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_list_auth_reconciliation(p_business_id uuid, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, operation text, auth_user_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF auth.role() IS DISTINCT FROM 'service_role' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'service role required' USING errcode = '42501';
  END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
    SELECT r.id, r.operation, r.auth_user_id
    FROM public.auth_reconciliation r
    WHERE r.business_id = p_business_id AND r.state = 'pending'
    ORDER BY r.created_at
    LIMIT greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_limit, 20), 100));
END;
$function$

functions.name: admin_require_caller_business_id
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_require_caller_business_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  bid uuid;
begin
  select s.business_id
    into bid
  from public.staff s
  where s.auth_user_id = auth.uid()
    and s.active is true
    and s.terminated_at is null
    and s.role in ('owner', 'admin')
  limit 1;

  if bid is null then
    raise exception 'not authorized'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  return bid;
end;
$function$

functions.name: admin_overview
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_overview()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  bid uuid := public.admin_require_caller_business_id();
  result jsonb;
begin
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'active_staff', (
      select count(*)::int from public.staff s
      where s.business_id = bid and s.active and s.terminated_at is null
    ),
    'disabled_staff', (
      select count(*)::int from public.staff s
      where s.business_id = bid and not s.active and s.terminated_at is null
    ),
    'terminated_staff', (
      select count(*)::int from public.staff s
      where s.business_id = bid and s.terminated_at is not null
    ),
    'active_owners', (
      select count(*)::int from public.staff s
      where s.business_id = bid and s.role = 'owner'
        and s.active and s.terminated_at is null
    ),
    'active_admins', (
      select count(*)::int from public.staff s
      where s.business_id = bid and s.role = 'admin'
        and s.active and s.terminated_at is null
    ),
    'shops', (
      select count(*)::int from public.shops sh where sh.business_id = bid
    ),
    'active_shops', (
      select count(*)::int from public.shops sh
      where sh.business_id = bid and sh.active
    ),
    'recent_activity', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(row_to_json(x)::jsonb)
      from (
        select a.id, a.at, a.action, a.target_username, a.detail
        from public.audit_log a
        where a.business_id = bid
        order by a.at desc, a.id desc
        limit 10
      ) x
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  ) into result;

  return result;
end;
$function$

functions.name: admin_list_shops
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_list_shops(p_limit integer DEFAULT 50, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  bid uuid := public.admin_require_caller_business_id();
  lim int := greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_limit, 50), 100));
  off int := greatest(0, least(coalesce(p_offset, 0), 100000));
  result jsonb;
begin
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(row_to_json(x)::jsonb), '[]'::jsonb)
  into result
  from (
    select
      sh.id as shop_id,
      sh.name,
      sh.active,
      sh.created_at,
      (
        select count(*)::int
        from public.staff_shops ss
        join public.staff st on st.id = ss.staff_id
        where ss.shop_id = sh.id
          and st.business_id = bid
          and st.terminated_at is null
      ) as assigned_staff_count
    from public.shops sh
    where sh.business_id = bid
    order by sh.name asc
    limit lim
    offset off
  ) x;

  return result;
end;
$function$

functions.name: admin_get_shop
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_get_shop(p_shop_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  bid uuid := public.admin_require_caller_business_id();
  result jsonb;
begin
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'shop_id', sh.id,
    'name', sh.name,
    'active', sh.active,
    'created_at', sh.created_at,
    'business_id', sh.business_id,
    'assigned_staff', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'staff_id', st.id,
          'username', st.username,
          'display_name', st.display_name,
          'role', st.role,
          'active', st.active,
          'terminated_at', st.terminated_at
        )
        order by st.username
      )
      from public.staff_shops ss
      join public.staff st on st.id = ss.staff_id
      where ss.shop_id = sh.id
        and st.business_id = bid
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'owners', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'staff_id', ow.id,
          'username', ow.username,
          'display_name', ow.display_name,
          'role', ow.role,
          'active', ow.active,
          'terminated_at', ow.terminated_at
        )
        order by ow.username
      )
      from public.staff ow
      where ow.business_id = bid
        and ow.role = 'owner'
        and ow.terminated_at is null
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  )
  into result
  from public.shops sh
  where sh.id = p_shop_id
    and sh.business_id = bid;

  if result is null then
    raise exception 'not found' using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  return result;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_require_write_caller()
 RETURNS TABLE(business_id uuid, staff_id uuid, username text, caller_role text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
    SELECT s.business_id, s.id, s.username, s.role
    FROM public.staff s
    WHERE s.auth_user_id = auth.uid()
      AND s.active IS TRUE
      AND s.terminated_at IS NULL
      AND s.role IN ('owner', 'admin')
    LIMIT 1;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not authorized'
      USING errcode = '42501';
  END IF;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_write_audit(p_business_id uuid, p_action text, p_target_username text, p_detail jsonb, p_performed_by uuid, p_performed_by_username text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  cleaned jsonb;
BEGIN
  cleaned := public.redact_json_secrets(p_detail);

  INSERT INTO public.audit_log (
    action,
    target_username,
    detail,
    business_id,
    performed_by,
    performed_by_username
  ) VALUES (
    p_action,
    p_target_username,
    cleaned,
    p_business_id,
    p_performed_by,
    p_performed_by_username
  );
END;
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_record_auth_reconciliation(p_operation text, p_auth_user_id uuid, p_target_username text, p_last_error text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  caller record;
BEGIN
  -- We assume this is called by Vercel API via service_role key or user key.
  -- Wait, if it's called by service_role key, auth.uid() is null!
  -- We'll allow it if called with service_role bypass. But since it's an RPC, 
  -- service_role can call it. If auth.uid() is null, it's service role.
  IF auth.role() != 'service_role' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only service_role can record auth reconciliation' USING errcode = '42501';
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.auth_reconciliation (
    business_id, operation, auth_user_id, target_username, last_error
  ) 
  -- We need business_id. Find it from the target username, or fallback.
  SELECT business_id, p_operation, p_auth_user_id, p_target_username, p_last_error
  FROM public.staff 
  WHERE username = p_target_username 
  LIMIT 1;
END;
$function$
functions.identity_arguments: p_operation text, p_auth_user_id uuid, p_target_username text, p_last_error text

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_ensure_not_last_active_owner(p_business_id uuid, p_excluding_staff_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_owner_count int;
BEGIN
  -- Replaced SELECT count FOR UPDATE with simple count, 
  -- as the caller now acquires the businesses lock first.
  SELECT count(id) INTO v_owner_count
  FROM public.staff
  WHERE business_id = p_business_id
    AND active = true
    AND terminated_at IS NULL
    AND role = 'owner'
    AND (p_excluding_staff_id IS NULL OR id != p_excluding_staff_id);

  IF v_owner_count < 1 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cannot perform this action: must leave at least one active owner'
      USING errcode = 'P0001'; -- LAST_OWNER equivalent
  END IF;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_update_auth_reconciliation(p_reconciliation_id uuid, p_resolved boolean, p_error_code text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF auth.role() IS DISTINCT FROM 'service_role' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'service role required' USING errcode = '42501';
  END IF;
  UPDATE public.auth_reconciliation
  SET state = CASE WHEN p_resolved THEN 'resolved' ELSE 'pending' END,
      resolved = p_resolved,
      error_code = CASE WHEN p_resolved THEN NULL ELSE p_error_code END,
      attempt_count = attempt_count + 1,
      last_attempt_at = now(),
      resolved_at = CASE WHEN p_resolved THEN now() ELSE NULL END,
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = p_reconciliation_id AND state = 'pending';
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'reconciliation record not found' USING errcode = '42P01';
  END IF;
END;
$function$
functions.identity_arguments: p_reconciliation_id uuid, p_resolved boolean, p_error_code text

functions.name: admin_reconcile_reset_audit
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_reconcile_reset_audit(p_reconciliation_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  pending record;
BEGIN
  IF auth.role() IS DISTINCT FROM 'service_role' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'service role required' USING errcode = '42501';
  END IF;
  SELECT * INTO pending
  FROM public.auth_reconciliation
  WHERE id = p_reconciliation_id
    AND operation = 'reset_audit'
    AND state = 'pending'
  FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'reconciliation record not found' USING errcode = '42P01';
  END IF;
  PERFORM public.admin_write_audit(
    pending.business_id,
    'reset_server_credential',
    pending.target_username,
    jsonb_build_object('reconciled', true),
    pending.performed_by,
    pending.performed_by_username
  );
  UPDATE public.auth_reconciliation
  SET state = 'resolved', resolved = true, error_code = NULL,
      attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, last_attempt_at = now(),
      resolved_at = now(), updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = p_reconciliation_id;
END;
$function$

functions.name: sync_pull
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_pull(since_seq bigint DEFAULT 0, max_rows integer DEFAULT 200, shop uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'server_time_epoch_ms', (extract(epoch from now()) * 1000)::bigint,
    'records', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'server_seq', r.server_seq,
        'shop_id', r.shop_id,
        'table', r.table_name,
        'uid', r.row_uid,
        'payload', r.payload,
        'origin_device', r.origin_device,
        'received_at', r.received_at
      ) order by r.server_seq)
      from (
        select sr.* from public.sync_records sr
        where sr.server_seq > since_seq
          and (shop is null or sr.shop_id = shop)
          and sr.shop_id in (select public.sync_staff_shop_ids())
        order by sr.server_seq
        limit least(greatest(coalesce(max_rows, 200), 1), 500)
      ) r
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  )
$function$
functions.identity_arguments: since_seq bigint, max_rows integer, shop uuid
